config.novaxlights.max_distance.tooltip:
The maximum radius of the light.
Minimum: 1.
config.novaxlights.max_angle.tooltip:
The maximum angle of the light.
Minimum: 0.1.
config.novaxlights.angle_editor_value.to:
The value changed by the Angle Editor.
Minimum: 0.001.
tooltip.novaxlights.point_light_block.to:
§8Circular light.
§8Click with a dye to change the color of the light.
§8Use the Light Editor to change the radius of the light.
§8The intensity of the light is based on the redstone signal.
tooltip.novaxlights.area_light_block.too:
§8Angled light.
§8Click with a dye to change the color of the light.
§8Use the Light Editor to change the radius of the light.
§8The intensity of the light is based on the redstone signal.
tooltip.novaxlights.point_light_editor.t:
§8Primary hand: Increase the radius of the light.
§8Secondary Hand: Decrease the radius of the light.
tooltip.novaxlights.area_light_editor.to:
§8Primary hand: Increase the angle of the light.
§8Secondary Hand: Decrease the angle of the light.
